title: Impact of Attack at Saudi Arabia Oil Supply Facilities on Singapore’s Economy
what_it_is: Impact of Attack at Saudi Arabia Oil Supply Facilities on Singapore’s Economy

sections.label: Oil price impact on Singapore
sections.summary: Brent crude surged after the 14 September 2019 Saudi attacks, then stabilised, and MTI assesses limited impact on Singapore's economy and consumer prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In the immediate aftermath of the 14 September 2019 attacks on Saudi Arabia’s oil infrastructure, the benchmark Brent crude oil price surged from US$60 to US$71 per barrel.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: However, it retreated when Saudi Arabia and the United States (US) pledged to maintain a steady supply of oil, and it has since stabilised at around US$59 per barrel.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For 2019 as a whole, the Brent oil price is projected to average US$63 per barrel, lower than the US$71 per barrel in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Given that global oil prices have stabilised and oil production capacity in Saudi Arabia has returned to normal, the Ministry of Trade and Industry's (MTI's) assessment is that the impact on the Singapore economy is likely to be limited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Second, the impact on consumer prices is likely to be small.

sections.label: Diversifying energy supply sources
sections.summary: Singapore ensures energy supply resilience by diversifying its sources of crude oil and gas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: First, we ensure resilience in our energy supply by diversifying our sources of crude oil and gas.

sections.label: OEM electricity bill savings
sections.summary: Since the OEM launched in May this year, households and small businesses reported savings of about 20% to 30% on electricity bills.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Since we launched the OEM in May this year, households and small businesses have reported savings of about 20% to 30% on their electricity bills.

sections.label: LNG sources and household switching
sections.summary: Diversified LNG sources mean electricity supply is well taken care of, and about 18% to 20% of households have chosen to switch.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: With the diversified sources of LNG, where we can source from different places, our electricity supply is well taken care of.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But, on average, it is about 18% to 20% of the households have chosen to switch.
